examples.prompt: Run iteration 1 of the self-refinement loop on the base kernel.

base_kernel_path.description: Path to the kernel this stage works from. The baseline comes from outside the run, and every prompt in this package passes it as `{base_kernel_path}`.

prompt.description: What the caller needs done, in its own words. Required, and the only required field: the kernel-worker dispatches with prose naming file paths, and the delegation hook strips `prompt` as routing metadata unless the target schema declares it -- leaving an empty payload that can never conform. The typed fields below stay available for a caller that can supply them.

work_dir.description: Fully resolved slot of the kernel this iteration works on, `<artifacts>/tpu-kernel-development/<slot>`, where `<artifacts>` is the request's own run and `<slot>` is `k` and two or more digits. Required: one session can optimize several kernels, one slot each, and only tpu-kernel-development knows which slot is this kernel's -- a `<work>` derived from `run_id` alone would be shared by every kernel in the session, so the second would resume or overwrite the first.
